description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll join a fast-growing fintech engineering team as a Software Engineer, building and scaling end-to-end production systems for a complex B2B product. This is a full-stack role spanning thoughtful, performant UIs all the way through complex data modeling and large-scale integrations, with real ownership from day one.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Build and scale end-to-end production systems for a complex B2B product.

 - Own features from conception through launch and iteration.

 - Work directly with stakeholders to understand problems and drive solutions.

 - Build shared abstractions and experiences that make complex products intuitive.

 - Raise the engineering bar through excellent code, thoughtful reviews, and clear communication.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 3+ years building end-to-end production systems for B2B products, with experience owning features from conception through launch.

 - Strong full-stack fundamentals: able to trace requests from UI to data store and make sound technical decisions at every layer.

 - Proficiency with TypeScript and React for frontend development.

 - Proficiency with Node.js and Python for backend development.

 - Experience with relational databases (Postgres) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).

 - Experience with GCP for cloud infrastructure and deployment.

 - Experience building data pipelines, ETL processes, or large-scale data systems.

 - Background as a founder, engineering lead, or startup builder with high agency and a builder's mindset.

 - Familiarity with BigQuery, GitHub Actions CI/CD, and observability tools such as Datadog is a plus.

 - Experience in FP&A, finance technology, or data integration domains is a bonus.

 - Pragmatic approach: choosing the fewest and simplest tools that will actually work.

 - Clear, direct communication across both technical and non-technical audiences.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Salary: $75,000 to $265,000 USD annually.

 - Flexible hours and unlimited PTO.

 - Health insurance (US and Canadian employees).

 - 401(k) plan (US employees).

 - Provided laptop (MacBook Pro or Lenovo).

 - Regular in-person team retreats.

 - Visa sponsorship: Not available.


LOCATION

Fully remote, open to candidates based in the United States, Canada, and Latin America.
